Name: Marnie Sells Eggs--Companion Mod For Egg Bundles
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4]Marnie sells Eggs!

[/size][/color][size=3]This mod simply adds [color=#ffff00]eggs[/color] to [color=#ffff00]Marnie's shop[/color] to help you out with my bundles, should you need the assistance! Or, if you just want her to sell eggs. Up to you.

The eggs added to Marnie's shop are as follows:

[color=#ffff00]large egg (white)[/color] - [color=#00ff00]800g [/color]x5 a day
[color=#ffff00]egg (white)[/color] - [color=#00ff00]500g [/color]x5 a day
[color=#ffff00]large egg (brown)[/color] - [color=#00ff00]800g [/color]x5 a day
[/size][color=#ffff00]egg (brown)[/color] - [color=#00ff00]500g[/color] x5 a day[size=3]
[color=#ffff00]duck egg[/color] - [color=#00ff00]800g[/color] x1 a day
[color=#ffff00]void egg[/color] - [color=#00ff00]5000g [/color]x1 a day

This should help you complete almost all of the bundles, aside from a few that require gold or other egg adjacent items.

Or she just sells the eggs for your convenience lol[/size]
